statements.t: We expect to use this liquidity for operating expenses, investments in working capital, capital expenditures, interest, taxes, lease and purchase obligations, pension benefit obligations, dividends, and debt obligations and other long-term liabilities.
We believe that our current liquidity position and future cash flows from operations will enable us to fund our operations, both in the next twelve months and in the longer term.

The Company used a portion of the net proceeds from the offering to repay all outstanding borrowings under its Credit and Security Agreement and intends to use the remaining proceeds to fund the acquisition of the remaining 20% ownership interest in Enercon, pursue acquisition and partnership opportunities, and for general corporate purposes.
The Company has not determined whether additional repatriations will be required to fund U.S. operations.

We expect foreseeable liquidity and capital resource requirements in the ordinary course to be met through existing cash and cash equivalents and anticipated cash flows from operations, as well as borrowings available under our revolving credit facility, if needed.

In addition, the Company expects to settle the obligation associated with the remaining 20% ownership interest in Enercon by the first quarter of 2027 in accordance with the contractual settlement provisions described in Note 2, “Acquisitions.” The related liability was $114.0 million as of September 30, 2026.
Because there were no outstanding borrowings as of September 30, 2026, the Company does not currently expect material interest payments related to revolving borrowings for the remainder of 2026.
